name: @agenetes/acp-driver
description: L2 standard driver: the ACP-connected external-agent driver and its session management (AgentHandle, session registry/store, ensureAcpSession, ACP meta handling). Built on the @agenetes base (protocol + runtime) and its ACP-private transport (@agenetes/agentlet-host). Host-specific concerns (storage root path, profile-schema cache, per-turn render closure) are injected by L1.
